title: Advanced Retouching in Photoshop: Spot Healing, Two‑Pass Blemish Removal, and Frequency Separation (PHLEARN Day 24)
summary: PHLEARN’s Day 24 in the 30 Days of Photoshop series demonstrates a two-step, non-destructive approach to advanced retouching: first remove skin blemishes at the pore level using a spot-healing/removal workflow on a dedicated layer, then even out skin tone with a frequency separation action that creates a separate texture layer and a color layer. The tutorial emphasizes preserving skin texture, applying changes at both zoomed-in and zoomed-out scales, and using subtle, painterly blending with sampling via Alt/Option. It covers loading and applying a dedicated frequency separation action (with options for 8-bit JPEGs vs 16-bit RAW), blurring the texture to separate detail from color, organizing edits into a folder, and providing a downloadable PSD for practice. The session also notes the importance of not removing defining features (like moles) and points to a Flur Pro course for deeper learning.
